_comment: M10 acceptance script for `openhost --app showcase` (docs/ROADMAP.md
M10). Deterministic timeline over all three tabs:
0.05        Settings tab at rest — iOS 26 large title, floating tab bar
0.30-2.60   profile card -> pageSheet profile editor: mid-present
(sheet rising, dim fading in), settled, tap the name field
and type, Done -> mid-dismiss, dismissed with the card's
name written back
3.00-4.30   large-title collapse: drag the Settings list up ->
mid-collapse (34pt title sliding away, inline title fading
in), momentum, settled inline title over the scroll-edge
pocket
4.70-4.95   tap the Tasks tab -> capsule + tint move, Tasks stack
installed
5.30-6.30   flick the inset-grouped UITableView: mid-momentum (with
the scroll indicator) and settled
6.70-8.30   press a row (measured #DCDCDC selection flash), release ->
push the detail mid-transition and settled (the row stays
selected underneath, like UIKit), back -> pop
8.70-10.10  tap a checkbox: spring pop, then the row travels from
TODAY to the top of COMPLETED while every row after it
slides up and both cards resize
10.40-10.70 back to the Settings tab — still scrolled, still
collapsed, still holding the edited name (per-tab state)
Run: .build/release/openhost --app showcase --scale 2 \
--script scripts/showcase_demo.json --record out_showcase
